papers.title: Synthetic Study Alpha: CO2 photoreduction over Cu-doped catalysts
Synthetic Study Beta: CO2 photoreduction over N-doped catalysts

nodes.label: Cu-doped TiO2 samples

evidence.quote: We report a synthetic benchmark study on CO2 photoreduction using Cu-doped TiO2 samples and a fixed-bed reactor at 25 °C.
Cu-doped TiO2 samples were prepared by impregnation.

nodes.merge_basis: 同篇同类型同表述，合并为一个节点

nodes.label: at 25 °C

evidence.quote: We report a synthetic benchmark study on CO2 photoreduction using Cu-doped TiO2 samples and a fixed-bed reactor at 25 °C.
Under visible light at 25 °C, the Cu-doped catalyst shows a CO selectivity of 92% and outperforms the undoped catalyst, which reaches only 61% selectivity.
We conclude that Cu-doped TiO2 is more active than the undoped reference at 25 °C, while the origin of the selectivity gap is not resolved here.

nodes.label: at 15 °C

evidence.quote: This synthetic study examines N-doped TiO2 samples for CO2 photoreduction in a slurry reactor at 15 °C.
At 15 °C the N-doped catalyst reaches a CO selectivity of 88%, and it outperforms the undoped reference under the same condition.
These results show that N-doped TiO2 is active at 15 °C, but a direct comparison with the Cu-doped system tested at 25 °C cannot be made from these data alone.
